items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: And with George Williams I played.

ctx.x: Willie Parker, that's his man. I think the last parade I played was Willie Parker. The last carnival parade I played for the Eleanor Club. I think the last parade they had before the war, after I came out of service, I don't think I fooled with it. Well after I came out of service in 45 I played with Mr. Allen, old man Allen across the river, a couple of fumes, a few parades. And with George Williams I played.
Did you ever make any records?
